invariants.rationale: A method returning a list of results should not return null, as per good practice; an empty list is preferable.
instantTime is important for identifying commit instants and should not be null throughout the write path.
preppedRecords should be non-null to perform upsert operations; null records would not be upserted.
The size of a list returned by the method should never be negative.
The input list size should never be negative, by the semantics of Java lists.
